title: USF-1062 semantic-preserving optimisation readiness map
purpose: Record every USF-1062 optimisation as active, rejected, deferred, or advisory, with rationale, assurance boundaries, and operational-only timing pointers, and enforce overclaim guardrails so this map cannot be read as a readiness claim. It consolidates the child issues USF-1063 to USF-1068.

optimisations.summary: Refreshed current-main validation timing using the existing measure-command-timing and validate-aggregate profilers; per-family timing confirmed.
optimisations.assuranceBoundary: Operational evidence only; exact latest-run values recorded in the pull request, not committed to source, per the timing fixed-point policy.

optimisations.summary: Opt-in local git object mirror consumed as a read-only object alternate, plus always-on fail-closed event-SHA verification of the checkout.
optimisations.assuranceBoundary: Runner-local state is not authority; inert by default (no-op unless vars.USF_GIT_OBJECT_MIRROR is set); correctness guaranteed by HEAD equals GITHUB_SHA, not by the mirror; before/after checkout timing is an external operational record.

optimisations.summary: The validate job runs foundation-substrate-closure and proof-cockpit acceptance as explicit steps and again inside repo:validate; the standalone invocations are byte-identical to the aggregate families.
optimisations.rejectionReason: USF-PROOF-COCKPIT-002 mandates both the explicit workflow steps and their repo:validate membership as defense-in-depth. Removing the standalone steps would fail that fail-closed wiring rule, so the duplication is intentional and is retained.

optimisations.summary: validate-runtime and validate-enterprise execute in both repo:validate and parity within the validate job.
optimisations.deferralReason: Deferred by design. validatorParallelismPlan.equivalenceProofRequiredBeforeActivation is true (candidate D, USF-1039/USF-656); reshaping the aggregate command sets requires equivalence proof and a branch-protection topology decision not owned by USF-1062.

optimisations.summary: Proof-cockpit route/phase timing is measurable via proof-cockpit:compare; projection-only re-pin already exists for authority-bounded refresh.
optimisations.deferralReason: Churn reduction is limited to authority-bounded projection-only refresh, which already exists; deeper reduction is not safe without weakening proof-cockpit freshness (USF-PROOF-COCKPIT-009). Timing measured operationally; freshness rule preserved.

optimisations.summary: Promotion of affected-domain routing from warn-only advisory to bounded-active gating.
optimisations.deferralReason: Pinned warn-only by USF-OPT-CI-006. Promotion is candidate C/D deferred by design and requires an owner decision, an equivalence proof, and a branch-protection status-topology change; USF-1062 does not unilaterally weaken the guard.
equivalenceCriteriaForPromotion: The affected-set command family must be proven to cover the full repo:validate family for every changed-path class, with a machine-checkable equivalence proof.

Full-validation fallback must remain fail-closed on every mandatory fallback class (unknown path, workflow, lockfile, validator source, proof evidence, proof-cockpit, provider mode, environment, runtime/API ambiguity).
Planted-defect selftests must still fail closed under the affected-only path.
The required validate status context and branch protection must be preserved.
An explicit owner decision must authorise the branch-protection topology change.

optimisations.summary: Lockfile/toolchain-keyed pnpm store and pip download caches (read-only on PRs, writable on main).
optimisations.assuranceBoundary: Implemented under USF-1037 (candidate A/K). Cache hits never satisfy validation or proof; not re-implemented by USF-1062.

timingEvidence.measurementNoiseNote: Current-main measurement was taken while a concurrent agent shared the runner host; treat local timing as indicative only.

verdictMustNotBeGreenIf: an optimisation depends on runner-local or developer-working-tree state as authority
stale evidence is accepted as pass
a readiness, staging, production, deployment, live-provider, compliance, monetisation, store, UI, or human-acceptance claim is introduced

assuranceBoundaries: Timing reports are operational evidence only and are lowest authority.
The git object mirror is transport acceleration only; runner-local state is not authority.
Cache hits never satisfy validation or proof.
Proof-cockpit freshness, branch protection, and the required validate context are preserved.
No validator, planted-defect selftest, or fail-closed guard is weakened.
Deferred and rejected optimisations are recorded with rationale rather than forced.
isolationFromUsf1050: Realised only on the USF-1062 optimisation branch. It does not modify, rebase, push to, close, merge, or supersede any USF-1050 branch, PR, worktree, issue, evidence, or in-progress file set.
